title: Visuomotor_task
description: This dataset comprises intracranial EEG (iEEG) recordings from ten pediatric epilepsy patients undergoing intracranial monitoring for seizure localization, recorded while they performed a visuomotor task. Subjects completed five sessions of Speed Match, a finger-tapping visuomotor game on the Lumosity platform, during interictal periods. The dataset provides continuous iEEG signals along with trial timing information for finger tapping events, supporting research into visuomotor processing and cortical dynamics in epilepsy patients.
methods_description: Intracranial EEG was recorded continuously in .edf format from epilepsy patients undergoing clinical monitoring while they performed a visuomotor finger-tapping task (Speed Match) on the Lumosity platform across five sessions. Trial onset and offset samples for finger tapping events (coded as 101) were annotated within the iEEG files, with channel information provided in accompanying .tsv files.
